description: Run by the Renovate job on harvest (Forgejo repo adham/renovate). Every pull request goes through CI like any other; merging one is a staging deploy.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch npm updates of stable packages: one pull request a week. Majors, and 0.x packages where any bump can break, stay one pull request each.
Node.js moves as one: the Dockerfile's images, CI's node-version and @types/node, so the types never describe a different runtime.
docker-compose's Postgres is for local development and matches Neon's major version, 17. When Neon's changes, change this limit with it.
